Kaṃsadeśavyākaraṇa
Bud. by Saṅghavardhana. Cordier III. p. 433. [Page107-b]

Kaṃsanārāyaṇa_Lakṣmīnāthadeva
king of Mithilā (ascended, 1532 A. D.); patron of Harapati (Mantrapradīpa L. 2011). See also IO. i. p. 875b.

Kaṃsanidhana

Kaṃsanirvāṇadarpaṇa
kāvya by Devadatta Śarma.
Pt.. Gaya, 1905. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1906-28. 247. IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 1243.

Kaṃsapuramāhātmya
Oppert II. 7511.

Kaṃsamardanagopālamantra
MD. 6024.

Kaṃsavadha
poem or play. Q. in Tantrapradīpa of Maitreyarakṣita under Sūtra IV. i. 73. See also Intro. p. 1, edn. of Dhātupradīpa by Maitreyarakṣita, Varendra Res. Soc., Rajshahi, 1919. See next.

Kaṃsavadha
play or pageant or theme there of. mentioned by Patañjali, M. Bhāṣya, III. i. 25.

Kaṃsavadha
nāṭaka in 7 Acts. by Śeṣa Kṛṣṇa, son of Nṛsiṁha, composed a. the request of Giridhārin, son of Rājā Toḍaramalla, minister of Akbar.

Kaṃsavadha
nāṭaka. by Dāmodara (?). Text same a. that of Śeṣa Kṛṣṇa except for some change in the end. Bl. 4. BORI. 16 of 1872-73. BORI. D. XIV. 42 Gough p. 106.

Kaṃsavadha
nāṭaka. by Dharmasūri. Q. thrice a. a work of his in his Sāhityaratnākara. See NIA. II. p. 432. See also BBRAS. 161.

Kaṃsavadha
kāvya. by Rājacūḍāmaṇi Dīkṣita. Mentioned in the list of his works a. the end of his Kāvyadarpaṇa. See Hz. I. Extr. p. 86.

Kaṃsavadha
poem in 4 cantos. by Vāsudevan Potti of Mūtteṭat (1833-93 A. D.) in [Page108-b] Ceṅṅanūr in Kerala. See Contribution of Kerala to Skt. Lit., p. 267.

Kaṃsavadha_(kaṃsavaho)
Pkt. kāvya in 4 cantos by Rāmapāṇivāda. GD. 1734-37 (with chāyā; all inc.). Granthappura p. 84 (nos. 1734-35) (with chāyā). 1736-37 (all inc.). MT. 5190. Oppert I. 5918 (a..). PUL. II. p. 251. TCD. 511B. Tra. Ad. Rep. 1112. 104 (a..). Trav. Uni. 4117B (inc.). 10903. C. 2533B. T. 1041. L. 106C. Trippūṇittura I. 219. 291A. II. 41. 190. Triv. Cur. IV. 145 (inc. a..).
Ed.. A. N. Upadhye, Hindi Grantha Ratnakarakaryalaya, Bombay, 1940.

Kaṃsavadhacampū
by Keralavarman, Valiya Koil Tampurān of Trivandrum (1845-1914 A. D.); written in 1869.
--C. Sumanorañjinī by Sundararāja.
Text an. C. Pt.. (1) Tinnevelly, 1888. (2) Trivandrum, 1902.

Kaṃsavadhamahākāvya
in 21 cantos, giving practical illustrations in gr. by Mohana Bhaṭṭa alias Kavi Paṇḍita, patronised by King Devīsiṁha of the Bundela family. BBRAS. 1163 (inc.).

Kaṃsavadhākhyāna
paur. AK. 114.

Kaṃsāntakanāṭaka
in 5 Acts. by Hariyajvan, son of Lakṣmīnṛsiṁha. Prologue mentions Rāmarāja. Mysore I. p. 636 (ms. copied in 1768 A. D.)

Kaṃsārināṭaka
by Śeṣa Kṛṣṇa. See Kaṁsavadha.

Kaṃsārimiśra
father of Yaśodharamiśra, a. of Daivajñacintāmaṇi (NP. V. 86), Mantrārādhanadīpikā (IO. 2581. RASB. VIII. A. 6233) an. Vīravaracintāmaṇi (RASB. 10395).

Kaṃsāriśarman
--C. on Pratiṣṭhādimantra. SSPC. I. H. 30. I. 298. Varendra 105. 659.

Kanaka_(?)
Q. in Srh. p. 108. v. 10.

Kanakakalpa
tantra. on enticement etc. RASB. VIII. A. 6069.

Kanakakavi
Jain.
--Akṣayatṛtīyā. JBhP. I. 3. C.. Kanakakuśala's Akṣayatṛtīyā.

Kanakakīrtigaṇi
pupil of Jayamandira. Jain.
--C. on Meghadūta. Br. Mus. 225. Lz. 416. Weber 1544.
Pt.. Banaras, 1867. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1892-1906. 279.

Kanakakīrtimuni
Jain.
--Kaṣāyajayabhāvanā or Kaṣāyajayacatvāriṁśat. Jain. Skt. Praśasti Saṁgraha p. 171.
--Caturviṁśatijinastuti. Jhalrapatan p. 33.
--C. Bālāvabodha on Tatvārthasūtra of Umāsvāmin. BORI. 1077 of 1891-95.
--Dravyasamuccaya. Pannalal Bombay 27.
--Nandīśvarapaṅktipūjā. Jain.
See Jaina Sid. Bhās. XIII. i. p. 37.
--Navakārapaintīs vratapūjā. See ibid.

Kanakakīrtibhaṭṭāraka
identical with above ?
--Aṣṭāhnikasarvatobhadrapūjā.
--Aṣṭāhnikodyāpana.
See Jaina Sid. Bhās. XIII. i. p. 34.

Kanakakumārakathā
BP. p. 181b.

Kanakakuśala
Jain. pupil of Vijayasena an. Śānti- [Page140-b] candra, an. also of Kamalavijaya an. Somakuśala.
--Akṣayatṛtīyākathā. prose. JBhP. I. 2. See also NCC. I. Revised edn. p. 10a.
--Kārttikaśuklapañcamīkathā. Written in A. D. 1599.
Pt.. Jñānapañcamīmāhātmya or Varadattaguṇamañjarīkathānaka in Parvakathāsaṅgraha, Pt. I, Jaina Yaśovij. Granth. 16.
--Jinastuti, 1585 A. D.
[--Jñānapañcamīkathā, another name of Kārttikaº; see above].
--Jñānapañcamīstavana. Ujjain I. p. 91 (with C.).
--Dattamañjarīkathā. Ujjain I. p. 89.
--Dānaprakāśa. Skt. verse. 1600 A. D.;
Pt.. by Pt. Hiralal.
--Dīpālikākalpa. Pkt. Jainagranthāvalī p. 270.

--Rohiṇīkathā or Rohiṇī-aśokacandra(nṛpa) kathā. 1601 A. D.

Pt.. Jamnagar, 1917.

--C. (Skt.) on Uddyotapañcamīstuti, 1596 A. D. See NCC. II. p. 338a.
--C. (Skt.) on Ṛṣabhanamrastotra, 1596 A. D. See above p. 37a. [Page141-a.
--C. (Skt.) on Kalyāṇamandirastotra, 1596 A. D. Pt.. Seth Devchand Lalbhai Jain Pustakoddhar Fund Series 79, Surat, 1932.

--C. (Skt.) on Sarvajinastotra of Ratnākarasūri.

--C. (Skt.) on Snātasyetivīrastuti of Bālacandra 1602 A. D.

Kanakacandra
a colleague of Vācanācārya Pūrṇakalaśagaṇi, a. of Stambhanakapārśvastuti.
See under BORI. D. XIX. ii. 566.

Kanakacandra
--C. on Pṛthvīcandracaritra. Jainagranthāvalī p. 227.

Kanakajānakī
nāṭaka. by Kṣemendra. Q. by him in Kavikaṇṭhābharaṇa. K. M. Gucch. IV. p.. 159, 165-7.

Kanakadattavaidya
--Tailārṇava. med. on the use of various oils. IO. 6523.

Kanakadāsastava
Oppert II. 454.

Kanakadīpaka
med. by Ugrāditya or Ugrācārya. Jain. (C. 800 A. D.). Jaina Sid. Bhās. IV. ii. p. 117.
See NCC. II. p. 284.

Kanakadhārāśrīstava
or kanakadhArAstava or kanakadhArA zrIlakSmIstavarAja in 28 v.. by Veṅkaṭanātha. Adyar I. p. 178b. Prativādibhayaṅkar p. 15. no. 148.
Pt.. Br. St. Ratnāvalī Pt. I. p.. 114-18, Sri Venkatesvara Steam Press, 1934.

Kanakadhārāstava_(ºstuti,_ºstotra)
a.. but probably the one ascribed to Śaṅkara. Āḍhyan Nambūdripād 101B. Jodiya II. 59. Kotah 978. TD. 19520-8.

Kanakadhārāstava
(ºstuti, ºstotra or kanakadhArAlakSmIstava or lakSmIstava or kanakalakSmIstava) Mss. show slight difference in the no. of verses. by Śaṅkarācārya.
Adyar I. p. 189a (inc. a. wrongly given). Allahabad 111. 105. Burnell 200a. GD. 1147D. 1213A2 (At the end there are 7 v.. on certain elements of [Page142-a. good conduct which one desirous of prosperity should observe along with the recital of the present hymn. Also 4 more v.. in praise of Śāstṛ, Śani an. Subrahmaṇya). 1225P. 4242U. 1272K. Gov. Or. Libr. Madras 15 (2 mss.). Granthappura p. 61. no. 1213 (z). p. 63. no. 1242 (t). Vani Vilas Press, Srirangam.
--C. by Kṛṣṇapurī Bhikṣu. Trav. Uni. 1399A (with text).

Kanakanandi
Jain. pupil of Abhayanandi an. teacher of Nemicandra Siddhāntadeva, end of 10th an. beg. of 11th Cent. an. a. of Bṛhad-an. Laghu-Dravyasaṅgraha; had a hand in composing some of Nemicandra's works like Gommaṭasāra.
See N. Premi, Jain Sāh. aur Itihās, p.. 296, 298.

Kanakanandi
--Vistarasatvatribhaṅgī, Sattvatribhaṅgī, Sattvasthānabhaṅgī. All these 3 titles probably ref. to same work. [Page142-b]
BBRAS. 1613 (5). Moodbidri I. 75 (h). II. 101 (j).
A Sattvasthāna is mentioned in Karmakāṇḍa a. a work of a Kanakanandi. May be identical with Nemicandra's teacher.

Kanakanandyācārya
Jain.
--Karmaprakṛti. Pkt. Moodbidri II. 21 (a.. Same a. Nemicandra's teacher ?

Kanakanandyācārya
Jain.
--Pañcaprarūpaṇa. Pkt. Moodbidri II. 20 (a..

Kanakaprabha
pupil of Devānanda an. preceptor of Pradyumnasūri (a. of C. on Pravrajyāvidhāna, BORI. D. XVII. iv. 1374 who assisted in composing the Prabhāvakacarita of Prabhācandra, BBRAS. 1755 an. Śālibhadracarita of Dharmakumāra, BBRAS. 1779).
--Śāntināthacaritra. Jainagranthāvalī p. 241.

Kanakaprabha
Jain; pupil of Devendra, pupil of Udayacandra, pupil of Hemacandra.
--C. Nyāsasāra on Hemacandra's Śabdānuśāsana, written under instruction of Udayacandra; in some mss., it appears a. if Udayacandra wrote it. Jainagranthāvalī p. 299. Jesalmere p. 53. Oxf. II. 1140 (i). Weber 1682.

Kanakamañjarī
TCD. 1019C (fr. contained in last leaves of the ms. in the codex). C.. next entry.

Kanakamañjarī
alchemy. by Nāgārjuna. MT. 3364 (b).

Kanakarañjanakaraṇa
mantra. Burnell 208b (no. 12162). TD. XX. Sup. no. 927 (v..

Kanakarathakathā
Jain. Jainagranthāvalī p. 248.

Kanakarathacaritra
Jain. Jainagranthāvalī p. 221.

Kanakalatā
Jain. JASB. 1908, p. 412a (no. 7588). [Page143-a.

Kanakalekhākalyāṇa
nāṭaka in 4 Acts on the marriage of Kanakalekhā, daughter of Vīravarman. by Vāmanabhaṭṭa Bāṇa.
Adyar II. p. 27b. Adyar D. V. 1341. MT. 5168. Paliyam 161. 914. Trav. Uni. T. 1279 (inc.).

Kanaka(kā)vatīmādhava
śilpaka variety of play. mentioned in the Sāhityadarpaṇa, VI. 300/301; Nāṭakalakṣaṇaratnakośa, Oxford 1937, l. 3029; in Alaṁkārasaṅgraha, IX. 140-1.

Kanakavarṇapūrvayoga
Bud. sūtra. AMG. II. p. 286. AR. XX. p. 483. Nanjio 390 (Chin. transl. 434-550).

Kanakavarṇaprajñāpāramitā
Bud. Nepal II. p. 200 (2 mss.).

Kanakavarṇaprajñāpāramitāsādhana
Bud. Cordier II. p. 384. III. p.. 19. 48 (nos. 243. 245). Nepal II. p. 267 (2 mss.).
Pt.. Sādhanamālā, Vol. I. GOS. XXVI. nos. 152. 156. 158. p.. 312. 317-8. 320-1.

Kanakavallīpariṇaya
nāṭaka. Oppert I. 4557.

Kanakavijaya
--Guruparipāṭīvarṇana. Jain. Pkt. Ujjain I. p. 88.

Kanakavijaya
pupil of Hīravijayasūri an. predecessor of Meghavijaya, a. of Pañcākhyānoddhāra. IO. 7313. See also Oxf. II. 1401 for a Kanakavijaya, in the line of Vijayagaṇi (Ariṣṭanemicarita).

Kanakaśakti
writer on theft (taskara-vidyā). Q. in Kalandikāprakāśa of Somanātha Vyāsa, fol. 83a of Ujjain ms.

Kanakaśrī
a. of Nālandā ins., assigned to 1st half of 12th Cent. A. D., of Vipulaśrīmitra, a Buddhist ascetic. See Epi. Ind. XXI. p.. 97. 99. [Page143-b]

Kanakasaptati
sāṁkhya. See Suvarṇasaptati.

Kanakasabhānāthamāhātmya
or hemasabhAº paur. taken from the Ekādaśarudrasaṁhitā an. included a. chs. 82-92 of Śaṅkaravilāsa compiled by Vidyāraṇya. On the famous shrine of Naṭarāja a. Cidambaram.
Adyar I. p. 149b. IO. 6957 (p. 1051a). MT. 4263 (b)

Kanakasabhāpati
--Bhāṣāmālā (?) PUL. II. p. 274 (under prose story).

Kanakasabhāpati
son of Timmanāyaka.
--C. Lalitā on Vṛttaratnākara of Kedāra. Adyar II. p. 39a. Adyar D. VI. 775-76.

Kanakasabhāpati
son of Yajñanārāyaṇa of Kauśika gotra an. father of Vīlinātha, a. of Madanamañjarīnāṭaka. MT. 2807. TCD. 1308. TD. 4430. 4431.

Kanakasabhāpati
son of Vaidyanātha of Maudgalyagotra; earlier than Laghuvaidyanāthīya, evidently the Smṛtimuktāphalasaṁkṣepa by Śivarāmamakhin (C. 1700), summary of his father's work; see MD. 3084, q. in Śrāddhanirṇaya.
--Kārikāmañjarī. Baudh. Ref. to also a. Baudh. gṛhyakārikā an. Baudh. smārtaprayoga, both pūrva an. apara. Burnell 20a. Hz. 672. Extr. TD. 11799-11805.
--Prayogādarśa. Baudh. in the form of a C. on the above. IO. 4816. MT. 3399. 5791.
--Mantrānukramaṇī. Ref. to in the above. Acc. to a.'s own statement the Kārikāmañjarī was written first, then Mantrānukramaṇī an. then Prayogādarśa.

Kanakasabhāpati
of Śrīvatsagotra, father of Sāmbaśiva, of Gopālasamudram village [Page144-a. in Tirunelveli Dist., a. of Śṛṅgāravilāsabhāṇa, MT. 3340. Sāmbaśiva wrote in the court of Mānavikrama, a. Zamorin of Calicut.

Kanakasabhāpatistotra
Trav. Uni. L. 722M.

Kanakasabhāpatīya
gṛh. one of the three works ref. to above under Kanakasabhāpati. Kaḍayanallūr 29. 30.

Kanakasabhāvallabha
son of Vīlinātha.
--C. Dīpti on his father's Rāmānvayabhūṣaṇa. MT. 4084 (a..

Kanakasiha
of Gauravaṁśa, father of Kīrtisiṁha in whose name is written the Kīrtiprakāśa of Viṣṇuśarman. IO. 1682. See Kīrtiprakāśa an. Kīrtisiṁha below.

Kanakasiṃhaprakāśa
med. by Rāmakṛṣṇa Vaidyarāja. Kāśīn. 34. C.. Kanakasiṁhavilāsa below an. also Kanakasiṁha above.

Kanakasiṃhavilāsa
med. Radh. 31. C.. Kanakasiṁha an. Kanakasiṁhaprakāśa above.

Kanakasundara
--Mādhavānalakāmakandalākathā. kāvya. CPB. 4106. Oudh V. 6 (ms. dated 1845 A. D.). C.. Kanakasundaragaṇi in BORI. D. XVII. iii. 724.

Kanakasena
pupil of Ajitasena an. grand-preceptor of Malliṣeṇa (a. of Bhairavapadmāvatīkalpa, Mahāpurāṇa etc.). IO. ii. p. 711a (a. the end of ms. of Bhairavapadmāvatīkalpa). See N. Premi, Jain Sāh. aur Itihās, p. 413.

Kanakasenavādirāja
I. 1000 A. D. pupil of Vimalacandra an. preceptor of Vādirāja II (a. of Pārśvanāthacarita an. Yaśodharacarita) an. teacher of Būtuga an. Rācamalla I. Mentioned a. end of Vādirāja II's Nyāyaviniścayavivaraṇa, Bhāratīya Jnānapīṭha edn. II. p. 369, l. 6. [Page144-b]

Kanakācārya
jy. writer q. in Kalyāṇavarman's Sārāvalī, N. S. Press edn. LIII. 1. 1914.

Kanakādrikhaṇḍa
in Skandapurāṇa.
--Kokilāmāhātmya from. Oxf. 84b (Index only). SB. 236.

Kanakādrimāhātmya
from Skandapurāṇa. Ben. 46.

Kanakābhri_(?)
name of Mahāmudgala's C. on the a.. Rāmaratnākara, PUL. II. p. 62 (2 mss.); but this name is not found in Hpr. IV. 236 where another ms. of it is noticed.

Kanakāmara
Jain. pupil of Maṅgaladeva or Budha Maṅgaladeva, C. 1065 A. D.; written a. Asaiya, a. the instance of the minister of King Vijayapāla, perhaps of Bundelkand.
--Karakaṇḍacariu. Apabhraṁśa.
See Intro., H. L. Jain edn. of text, Karanja Jain Series 4, Karanja, 1934. See also Allahabad Uni. Studies I (1925) 173-74 an. Jaina Sid. Bhās. XX. ii. p. 14.

Kanakāvatīcaritra
or Rūpasenacaritra. Jain. Mag. & Skt. by Jinasūri. BORI. 336 of 1871-72. D. p. 36. Gough p. 97. Jainagranthāvalī p. 221.

Kanakāvalī
vedic. on vedic śākhās an. particulars on the Śukla Yv. an. sage Yājñavalkya its promulgator. by Nārāyaṇa of Śrīmuṣṇam.
Adyar I. p. 158b. Oppert II. 3978. A private ms. with D.. V. Raghavan.
Ed. V. Raghavan, Adyar Library Bulletin on the basis of both these mss., 1966.

Kanikabhadra
Yv. Oudh XXI. 8. XXII. 2 (4 mss.). [Page145-a.

Kaniṣṭhaṛgvidhāna
ascribed to Śaunaka. IO. 4253.
C.. above p. 8b, under Ṛgvidhāna, Laghu.

Kantākathāyo_(?)
BP. p. 171b.

Kantesara
(variant dhIra) poet. Gāthāsaptaśatī I. 66.

--Karmavipākasārasaṅgraha or Sāragrāhaka karmavipāka. dh. Baroda 102 etc. Bikaner 1623. 1624. BORI. 264 of 1884-87. See Kṛṣṇadeva above.

Kānha(nhu)deva
son of Dvivedi Guṇadeva, of Traividya Modhavaṁśa; of Kāśī. [Page343-a.
--Nityasnānapaddhati(-vidhi) following the Trikāṇḍasūtra or Snānapariśiṣṭa of Kātyāyana; revised by his son Kṛṣṇadeva in 1764 A. D. Baroda 4011. Mithilā I. 244. RASB. II. 1188.

Kānha(hna)pāda
Bud. See Kṛṣṇapāda.

Kānhaprabhu(todaramalla)
son of Beimdevaprabhu an. Sāmāmbikā.
--C. Nidānacintāmaṇiṭīkā on Nidānasthāna, a part of Aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṁhitā. Mu7nchen J. 373. See NCC. I. p. 339a.
